About ZanCo

Senior Reporting Analyst working across Epic (Cogito) reporting and analytics, using Python and SQL to turn complex NHS data into clear, actionable insight.

I support King’s College Hospital NHS Foundation Trust and collaborate across the wider London healthcare ecosystem, with a particular focus on building robust datasets and dashboards across Clarity, Caboodle, Reporting Workbench, SlicerDicer, and Radar.

Alongside core reporting delivery, I’m contributing to the launch of one of the first predictive analytics models across GSTT and KCH — an inpatient “Likelihood of Discharge” model — helping operational and clinical teams plan capacity and patient flow with greater confidence.

With a BSc in Physics (First Class) and an MSc in Data Science (Distinction), plus experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, I bring a strong scientific foundation and practical modelling skills. I’m committed to high standards of data governance, quality, and usability, and to building analytics that genuinely improve patient pathways and outcomes.

What we are A holding company and venture builder: we create and own products, iterate them over time, and aim for durable fundamentals rather than hype.
What we’re not Not an agency. Not a consulting brand. Not a “growth hacks” factory. The goal is ownership and compounding.

How we build

ZanCo’s operating model is deliberately boring (the best kind): clear specs, reusable systems, careful compliance, and product decisions grounded in evidence.

Shared standards

  • Single visual identity system (Z master mark + ZCo lockup).
  • Consistent design tokens (dark mode first, high legibility, minimalism).
  • Privacy by default (especially for audio, location, and user-generated data).
  • Documentation-first: specs, build logs, and repeatable workflows.

Venture lifecycle

  • Idea → validation → MVP → iteration → operational hardening.
  • Each venture earns its own brand only when it proves traction.
  • ZanCo remains the quiet parent: governance, capital discipline, long horizon.
